3682-5330-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3682-5330-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Mox Amber, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

1887-3967-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-3967-5254.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

654-2292-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2292-2577-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

122-328-728-2732.description:
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

240-1322-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-1322-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

348-792-1152-2992-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-792-1152-2992-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Totentanz triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

3457-5833-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
3457-5833-7791.description:
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Leafkin Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Leafkin Druid.
Repeat.

215-6478-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-7060.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5702-6664-7401.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
5702-6664-7401.notablePrerequisites: At least half of the basic lands in your library are Forests.
5702-6664-7401.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
When the Springbloom Druid token enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a land, then search your library for a basic Forest and another basic land and put them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel 
When the basic lands enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate both lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
Repeat from step 3 until your library contains no basic lands.
5702-6664-7401.notes: You can perform this combo if half the basic lands in your library aren't Forests, but you won't be able to grab all basic lands unless you supplement {G} to compensate. While you will put all basic lands onto the battlefield, you'll have to sacrifice half of them to continue the combo. This won't affect how many landfall triggers, ETB triggers and creature tokens you get however.

413-628-7198.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Flitterwing Nuisance enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3000-3007-3899-4552.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3000-3007-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

277-2893-3470-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Lotus Cobra and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

539-2921-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

620-777-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-777-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

2173-2921-4740-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature
2173-2921-4740-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2173-2921-4740-5220.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

1778-2034-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3293-4693-5531.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
3293-4693-5531.description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3293-4693-5531.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1399-1606-2957-3664.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-6797-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-6797-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1399-1792-1825-3400.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to four lands excluding Wirewood Lodge that can tap to produce at least {G}{U}{U}.
You control an Elf that does not have summoning sickness.
1399-1792-1825-3400.description:
Activate Wirewood Lodge and up to four other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {C}{G}{U}{U}.
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting an Elf you control without summoning sickness.
Cast Treachery by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting a creature other than Ivy.
Ivy triggers, copying the Treachery spell, with the copy targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of the Treachery spell, creating a copy of Treachery attached to Ivy.
When the Treachery token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to four lands excluding Wirewood Lodge by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}{U}.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping the Elf.
Resolve the original Treachery spell.
When Treachery enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate the Elf by tapping it, returning the nontoken Treachery from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Wirewood Lodge and up to four other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {C}{G}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

1537-2921-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1456-5078-5864-6055.notablePrerequisites: Poison Dart Frog does not have summoning sickness.
1456-5078-5864-6055.description:
Activate Poison Dart Frog's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

132-2092-4131.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Myr Welder using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1829-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1829-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

940-4067-5467.easyPrerequisites: Arcane Teachings attached to Wylie Duke.
940-4067-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
940-4067-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wylie Duke ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

682-2060-4013-4929.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Supply Runners.
When Supply Runners enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1182-2034-2399-3693.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
1182-2034-2399-3693.description:
Sacrifice Walking Ballista to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Stonecoil Serpent for {1}.
Sacrifice Stonecoil Serpent to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Walking Ballista for {2}.
Repeat.
